messages:
ashley: Heads up — console telemetry shows ~12% of requests pinned by route rules hit fallback because model variant incompatible. Anyone digging?
leo: I saw that, looks like the `x-model-alias` header is being honored but version pins aren't checked for compatibility during gateway eval.
maya: We don't currently evaluate `compatibilityConstraints` in the gateway, right? Runtime does the heavy lifts and then rejects incompatible quantized/ops combos.
oliver: correct — gateway picks alias; runtime may reject and trigger fallback chaining. That causes a surprise spike in latency/cost.
ashley: Can we move a minimal compatibility check into the gateway? e.g. alias metadata like `supported_kernels`, `max_seq_length`, `quant_support` so route eval can short-circuit.
leo: cheap win: add a `required_features` bitmask on routing rules and a tiny capability table in gateway. If mismatch, try fallback variant at routing time.
maya: Consensus sounds good. Need to be careful with stale metadata — telemetry must detect incorrect mismatches.
ashley: UX: console pin/rollout modal should surface "compatibility risk" when you pin a model alias that has variants incompatible with tenant routing constraints.
oliver: Also quarantine quota accounting: pinned heavy models must decrement reserved capacity upfront, otherwise customers silently exceed expected spend.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: route-eval-capability-check v1 -> canary 10% at 2026-03-22T02:00Z.
leo: Telemetry proposal: emit `route_eval.capability_mismatch` with fields: alias, required_features, available_kernels (small list), decision. Keep payload compact to avoid cardinality.
maya: And surface aggregate metric `route.pinned_fallback_rate` per route + per-tenant. Alert if > 5% in 5m window.
ashley: I'll sketch a gateway PR: header metadata lookup, lightweight feature filter, telemetry emit, and a console flag to show "compat mismatch" in rollout UI.
oliver: +1. Pair on CI and canary plan: auto rollback if fallback_rate > 5% or tail latency > 2x baseline.
maya: Filing infra ticket for quota/accounting adjustments and a small schema change to alias metadata.
ashley: Thanks all — will post a short RFC draft here tomorrow with config examples and a minimal API change (read-only lookup endpoints for gateway). :thumbsup:
